prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: independently authored opaque photographic environment plate for a contemporary exhibition scene; not a website image and not a page mockup.
Primary request: Generate ONE new ultra-wide cinematic dark exhibition environment, 2560 x 1200 pixels, approximately 2.13:1. Use the reference ONLY for the environment's mood, palette, materials, relative framing and camera; independently author the scene. The reference's sculpture and interface must be completely absent.
Scene/backdrop: an empty almost-black navy contemporary gallery or underground exhibition hall. A large low rough dark basalt bank enters only at the extreme left edge and slopes down toward the left-of-center background. A separate smaller rugged basalt outcrop enters only from the far right lower edge. Keep both rock formations dark and low, cropped naturally at the side edges. A tall dark charcoal concrete wall occupies only the far right 18% of the frame, extending beyond the top edge; faint tactile concrete grain and one very subtle vertical edge are enough. The rest of the distant background is deep nearly black navy negative space.
Subject: empty atmospheric architectural space ONLY. There is no sculpture or centerpiece. All central and left foreground space remains clear for separately rendered real 3D geometry and real HTML typography.
Style/medium: photorealistic high-end exhibition architectural photography with believable basalt texture, quiet rough concrete and a barely reflective black floor; refined physical materials, subtle filmic low-light exposure, no painterly illustration.
Composition/framing: ultra-wide landscape 2.13:1, fixed low front view, broad empty middle from x=20% through x=82%. The dark floor runs across only the lower 20% of the image, with fine, dim, horizontal natural reflections and no bright reflected source. The lower left foreground is almost black and visually quiet. No objects or vertical structures cross the center. Match the reference's dark environmental framing rather than its sculpture or page layout.
Lighting/mood: extremely restrained blue rim light skims a few irregular ridges on the two edge rock banks. Overall almost-black ink-navy exposure, around #080b12, with charcoal shadows, the faintest muted steel-blue reflections and low-contrast concrete at the far right. Blue highlights are physical edge light, sparse and never neon. No extra light sources are visible.
Text (verbatim): ""
Constraints: environment only, opaque full-frame image, independent new pixels. Exclude ALL text, letters, logos, wordmarks, navigation, buttons, controls, lines, dividers, sliders, captions, interface and watermarks. Exclude ALL rings, circles, hoops, wires, glass structures, metal objects, sculpture, plinths, pedestals, people and furniture. No central pillars or arches. No added spotlights, glow orbs, beams, starfield, cosmic sky, fog clouds, colored gradients, decorative grids or patterned wall lights. Do not copy the reference image's actual pixels. Keep the center empty and dark.
